name: Dual Contouring Edge Normal Calculation
aliases: Edge Normal Calculation via Vertex Gradient Averaging
definition: Calculation of the normal for a grid edge by averaging the normals of the two vertices defining the edge.
summary: Dual Contouring Edge Normal Calculation averages gradient-based vertex normals to determine the orientation of an isosurface-intersected edge, enabling accurate feature point projection within the quadric error function.
